description: ADP: Android DevTools Protocol (docs/04-adp.md). CDP-style domains, commands, events, types. The version is contracts/adp/VERSION. Only shapes the docs and owner decisions fully define are listed. 64-bit integers are JSON decimal strings: type string with format int64 or uint64. 32-bit and smaller integers are JSON numbers: type integer, with format uint32 or int32 where the width is fixed. Type binary is a base64 string (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding), as in CDP. Extensions to the CDP structure: errors, envelope, scope on commands and events, targetTypes on commands, format, discriminator/variants on tagged unions, nullable on optional properties (explicit null clears the field). targetTypes lists the target types whose sessions accept the command; sent in the session of a target of another type: INVALID_REQUEST. A session-scoped command without targetTypes has no target type fixed yet.

errors.name: FRAME_EXPIRED
errors.description: The requested frameId is no longer in the ring buffer. No other frame is substituted.

errors.name: NOT_ACTIONABLE
errors.description: The action cannot be performed on the target.

errors.name: POLICY_DENIED
errors.description: Denied by policy, including an Authorizer denial at attach or at a command (authorization is checked again for every command in a session; an Authorizer failure counts as a denial).

errors.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
errors.description: The credential is missing or invalid, or a message arrived before authentication.

errors.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
errors.description: No protocol version both sides support.

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.description: The envelope is malformed: not a Request object, an id that is not an integer in range or duplicates an in-flight request, a sessionId missing on a session-scoped or present on a connection-scoped method, a sessionId this connection does not hold, a command in the session of a target type it does not accept (targetTypes), or a message the connection state does not allow: a command before Connection.hello, a second Connection.hello, Connection.auth on an authenticated connection, a second App.uploadChunk in flight for one upload, App.createUpload beyond the per-session upload limit (before authentication: UNAUTHENTICATED).

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
errors.description: The method names no command of this protocol version.

errors.name: INVALID_PARAMS
errors.description: The params do not follow the definition: a missing required value, a wrong type, an unknown enum value, an unknown union kind, a selector syntax error or unknown selector engine, an unknown diff format.

errors.name: UNIMPLEMENTED
errors.description: The command exists in this protocol version, but this server, or the layer that answers it, has not built it yet. Not METHOD_NOT_FOUND, which means the protocol version has no such command.

envelope.description: WebSocket text messages carry one JSON object each: Request (client to server), Response (server to client, one per Request), Event (server to client). Binary messages: see binary. A message above the maximum message size (a server setting) closes the connection with status 1009 (RFC 6455 section 7.4.1). The server sends a Ping (RFC 6455 section 5.5.2) at the keepalive interval (a server setting) and closes the connection (RFC 6455 section 7.1.1) when the number of unanswered Pings the keepalive setting allows is exceeded.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1. Unique among the in-flight requests of the connection; otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Absent for connection-scoped commands. Required for session-scoped commands. Otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

properties.name: method
properties.description: Domain.command. Unknown: METHOD_NOT_FOUND.

properties.name: traceparent
properties.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/ section 3.2). Untrusted. A value that does not follow section 3.2, including an all-zero trace-id or parent-id, is ignored (sections 3.2.2.3 and 3.2.2.4); the request is not rejected for it. Whether the server continues the client's trace or starts a new trace linked to it is a server setting; default: a new trace with a link.

properties.name: tracestate
properties.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate (section 3.3). Untrusted. Ignored when traceparent is absent (section 4.2) or ignored (sections 3.3 and 4.3).

types.description: Exactly one of result and error is present.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The id of the Request.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Present when the Request had one.

properties.name: method
properties.description: Domain.event.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Absent for connection-scoped events.

properties.name: code
properties.description: One of errors[].name. Same code space as contracts/common ErrorCode.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Further detail: the fields a command description names, and reason (a string): the component and operation that answered, as <component>#<operation>, the repository path of the component's module and the name of its operation (for example host/vmm/api#create). reason is for diagnosis; a client decides by code.

envelope.binary: A binary WebSocket message starts with an 8-byte big-endian unsigned integer, the id of the Request it belongs to; the rest is the payload. From the server: sent before the Response with that id. From the client: exactly one after each App.uploadChunk Request, with that Request's id; the server answers that Request only after receiving it, also when it rejects the Request. A client binary message that follows no pending App.uploadChunk Request with its id, and an App.uploadChunk Request whose id duplicates an in-flight request, close the connection with status 1002 (RFC 6455 section 7.4.1). The client sends no other binary messages.

domains.description: Connection setup. Authentication: an Authorization: Bearer header (RFC 6750) on the WebSocket upgrade, or auth as the first message. Until authenticated, every other message is rejected with UNAUTHENTICATED. A token in the URL query string is not accepted. Both paths use the Authenticator SPI. An upgrade whose Authorization header does not authenticate is refused with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token" (RFC 6750 section 3.1; RFC 6455 section 4.2.2 allows a status other than 101). A connection not authenticated within the authentication deadline (a server setting) is closed with status 1008 (RFC 6455 section 7.4.1). Failed authentication is rate-limited (a server setting, on by default): over the limit, an upgrade gets HTTP 429 (RFC 6585 section 4) with Retry-After (RFC 9110 section 10.2.3), and Connection.auth closes the connection with status 1008. Right after authentication, hello is required once before any other command. A connection is authenticated once; a new credential means a new connection.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Authenticates the connection when the upgrade carried no Authorization header. On failure the server answers UNAUTHENTICATED and closes the connection with status 1008 (RFC 6455 section 7.4.1). On an authenticated connection (by either path): INVALID_REQUEST; the connection keeps its credential.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque token as issued, in RFC 6750 b64token syntax; the same string as in Authorization: Bearer.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Version negotiation (docs/04-adp.md section 9). Required once per connection, right after authentication and before any other command; any other command before it, and a second hello, get INVALID_REQUEST. Compatible when the majors match, and for 0.x versions also the minors (semver caret rule). Otherwise UNSUPPORTED_VERSION with error.data {protocolVersion: the server's ADP version}, and the server closes the connection with status 1008; there is no retry on the same connection.

parameters.name: protocolVersion
parameters.description: The client's ADP version (semver).

returns.name: protocolVersion
returns.description: The server's ADP version (semver).

domains.description: CDP-style target model in flat session mode. Instances are top-level targets; display, window, process and webview targets sit beneath an instance. Attaching returns a sessionId. Authorization is checked at attach and again before every command in a session; a denial answers that command with POLICY_DENIED and then ends the session with detachedFromTarget reason authorizationRevoked. A webview target's session carries CDP messages unchanged (CDP flat-session mode, Target.attachToTarget with flatten); how the ADP envelope rules (id space, error object, the Target commands) apply inside such a session is not defined yet.

types.description: Opaque target ID.
Opaque session ID returned by attachToTarget.

properties.name: attached
properties.description: Whether this connection is attached to the target.

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: The target this one sits beneath. Absent for instance targets.

types.description: clientDetach: detachFromTarget on this session or on a session above it. targetGone: the session's target was destroyed (targetDestroyed is sent too). authorizationRevoked: a command in the session was denied by the Authorizer (POLICY_DENIED).

commands.name: getTargets
commands.description: Without a session: the instance targets. In a session: the targets beneath the session's target. Lists only targets the principal may attach to: a target the Authorizer denies, or for which it fails, is left out (fail closed).

commands.name: createTarget
commands.description: Creates a new instance and answers with its instance target once the instance is ready to use; targetCreated is sent for it. The instance is built from the server's configured defaults (which image and VM size is a server setting). Authorized as this command on the server, not on an instance. A failure on the way answers with the error, and no instance remains.

returns.name: targetId
returns.description: The new instance target.

commands.name: closeTarget
commands.description: Stops and destroys the instance target targetId. Every session attached to it or beneath it ends first (detachedFromTarget, reason targetGone), then targetDestroyed is sent. Authorized as this command on that instance. A targetId that names no existing target: TARGET_GONE. A target that is not an instance target: INVALID_PARAMS.

commands.name: attachToTarget
commands.description: Attaches to a target. Instance targets: without a session. Other targets: in the session of the target they sit beneath. Denied by the Authorizer: POLICY_DENIED. Gone: TARGET_GONE.

commands.name: detachFromTarget
commands.description: Detaches sessionId, any session of this connection, and every session beneath it. Each detached session gets detachedFromTarget with reason clientDetach. Afterwards a message with a detached sessionId gets INVALID_REQUEST. A sessionId this connection does not hold: INVALID_PARAMS.

events.name: targetCreated
events.description: Same scoping and authorization filter as getTargets.

events.name: targetDestroyed
events.description: Same scoping and authorization filter as getTargets.

events.name: detachedFromTarget
events.description: The session sessionId ended. Sent without a session for a session attached without one, otherwise in the session it was attached in. Sessions beneath it end first, each with its own event and the same reason. No message carries the ended sessionId afterwards.

types.description: Opaque node ID. Stable for the node's lifetime and never reused.
The frame that trees, screenshots and events refer to.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Display number.

properties.name: vsyncId
properties.description: Choreographer vsync ID (app side). Decimal string.

properties.name: sfFrame
properties.description: SurfaceFlinger frame number (composition side). Decimal string.

properties.description: WAI-ARIA 1.2 role name (https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/ section 5.3), from the node's className or Compose Role by the table contracts/adp/roles/role-map.json. Absent when the table has no entry for the node.

properties.name: bounds
properties.description: Screen pixels.

properties.name: actions

properties.name: webviewTargetId
properties.description: CDP target reference when the node is a WebView.

variants.description: A standard action (one of the AccessibilityAction ACTION_* constants).

properties.description: The constant's name, for example ACTION_CLICK.

types.description: Selector string. Grammar and semantics: contracts/adp/selectors/selector.ebnf. Conformance cases: contracts/adp/selectors/conformance.json. Syntax error or unknown engine: INVALID_PARAMS.
Tree diff format. nodeOps: TreeOp operations on node IDs. Extension point: a value the server does not know is rejected with INVALID_PARAMS.
Changed fields of a node. Absent: unchanged. null: the optional field is cleared. id and children never appear here; children change through insert, remove and move.
One nodeOps operation. Applied in array order; a parent is inserted before its children.

variants.description: Inserts node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent.
Removes the node with its subtree. Removed IDs are never reused.
Moves the node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent. The node keeps its ID.

commands.name: getTree
commands.description: Returns the unified tree of the session's display for one frame.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels below the root to include; -1: the whole tree. Below -1: INVALID_PARAMS.

commands.name: querySelector
commands.description: The first node, in document order, that selector matches in the tree of the session's display.

parameters.name: frameId
parameters.description: Absent: the latest committed frame of the session's display. A frame whose tree the server no longer holds: FRAME_EXPIRED. A frameId of another display: INVALID_PARAMS.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: The frame queried, always present.

returns.name: nodeIds
returns.description: At most one node.

commands.name: querySelectorAll
commands.description: Every node, in document order, that selector matches in the tree of the session's display.

parameters.name: frameId
parameters.description: As for querySelector.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: The frame queried, always present.

commands.name: getNode
commands.description: One node in the latest committed frame of the session's display, without children (children absent). Gone: NODE_GONE.

events.name: treeMutated
events.description: The tree changed from baseFrameId to frameId (format nodeOps). A client whose current frame is not baseFrameId re-fetches with getTree; ops are never applied to another base.

types.description: An action of AccessibilityNodeInfo (android.view.accessibility). Tagged union on kind. A server rejects a kind it does not know with INVALID_PARAMS.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The name of an AccessibilityNodeInfo.AccessibilityAction standard action constant (ACTION_*, for example ACTION_CLICK) defined by the server's Android release (versions.toml: android-17.0.0_r1). Unknown: INVALID_PARAMS.

properties.name: id
properties.description: AccessibilityAction.getId() of a custom action the node exposes (UI.NodeAction kind custom).

types.description: Arguments of AccessibilityNodeInfo.performAction(int, Bundle), named by the AccessibilityNodeInfo ACTION_ARGUMENT_* constants and typed as their documentation states (frameworks/base core/java/android/view/accessibility/AccessibilityNodeInfo.java at android-17.0.0_r1: int is int32, float is number, CharSequence and String are string). Each is put in the Bundle under the constant's value. A name not listed here: INVALID_PARAMS. Not supported: ACTION_ARGUMENT_SELECTION_PARCELABLE (type AccessibilityNodeInfo.Selection) and the hidden ACTION_ARGUMENT_ACCESSIBLE_CLICKABLE_SPAN.

properties.name: ACTION_ARGUMENT_DIRECTION_INT
properties.description: One of the android.view.View FOCUS_* values the constant's documentation lists.

properties.name: ACTION_ARGUMENT_SCROLL_AMOUNT_FLOAT
properties.description: A flagged API (Flags.FLAG_GRANULAR_SCROLLING); on a release where the flag is off: INVALID_PARAMS.

commands.name: performAction
commands.description: Calls AccessibilityNodeInfo.performAction(int, Bundle) on a node of the session's display tree. An action the node does not expose (UI.Node actions), or performAction returning false: NOT_ACTIONABLE. Gone: NODE_GONE.

parameters.name: resolveOn
parameters.description: Default: frameCommitted.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Bound on the wait for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: frameId
returns.description: Absent for resolveOn dispatched. Otherwise the latest committed frame of the session's display when the command resolved.

returns.name: conditionMet
returns.description: Present for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle: true when the awaited condition was reached, false when timeoutMs elapsed first.

types.description: When an input command resolves. dispatched: once the input is dispatched (no frameId). frameCommitted: at the first frame committed after the input took effect. idle: when the UI is idle. For frameCommitted and idle the wait is bounded by timeoutMs; the command succeeds either way, and conditionMet in the result says whether the awaited condition was reached. The idle criterion and the default timeoutMs are server settings.

How a node click is performed. accessibility: AccessibilityNodeInfo.performAction with the node's standard action (ACTION_CLICK for click, ACTION_LONG_CLICK for longClick). touch: a synthesized touch at the centre of the node's bounds. auto: accessibility when the node exposes that action, touch otherwise.

properties.name: id
properties.description: MotionEvent pointer ID, 0 to 31 (MAX_POINTER_ID, frameworks/native include/input/Input.h at android-17.0.0_r1). Otherwise INVALID_PARAMS.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Display physical pixels, screen coordinates.

properties.name: y
properties.description: Display physical pixels, screen coordinates.

commands.name: click
commands.description: Clicks a node of the session's display tree. method accessibility: performAction(ACTION_CLICK); a node that does not expose ACTION_CLICK, or performAction returning false: NOT_ACTIONABLE. method touch: ACTION_DOWN then ACTION_UP at the centre of the node's bounds; a node that is not visible, bounds with zero width or height, or a centre outside the display: NOT_ACTIONABLE. Gone: NODE_GONE.

parameters.description: Default: auto.

parameters.name: resolveOn
parameters.description: Default: frameCommitted.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Bound on the wait for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle. Default: a server setting.

returns.name: conditionMet
returns.description: Present for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle: true when the awaited condition was reached, false when timeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: longClick
commands.description: Long-clicks a node. As click, with ACTION_LONG_CLICK for method accessibility; for method touch the pointer stays down for the guest's long-press timeout (ViewConfiguration.getLongPressTimeout(), Settings.Secure.LONG_PRESS_TIMEOUT) plus a margin that is a server setting.

parameters.description: Default: auto.

parameters.name: resolveOn

returns.name: conditionMet
returns.description: Present for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle: true when the awaited condition was reached, false when timeoutMs elapsed first.

commands.name: dispatchTouch
commands.description: One touch event on the session's display in the android.view.MotionEvent model. type is the MotionEvent action. pointers lists every pointer that is down during the event with its position, at most 16 (MAX_POINTERS, frameworks/native include/input/Input.h at android-17.0.0_r1); for ACTION_POINTER_UP and ACTION_UP it still includes the pointer going up. Sequence rules: ACTION_DOWN starts a gesture with exactly one pointer; ACTION_POINTER_DOWN adds actionPointerId to the pointers already down; ACTION_MOVE keeps the same pointers; ACTION_POINTER_UP removes actionPointerId while at least one other pointer stays down; ACTION_UP ends the gesture with exactly one pointer; ACTION_CANCEL ends the gesture and lists all its pointers. An event that breaks these rules: INVALID_PARAMS, and nothing is dispatched.

parameters.name: actionPointerId
parameters.description: The pointer that goes down or up. Required for ACTION_POINTER_DOWN and ACTION_POINTER_UP, absent otherwise; else INVALID_PARAMS.

parameters.name: resolveOn
parameters.description: Default: frameCommitted.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Bound on the wait for resolveOn frameCommitted and idle. Default: a server setting.

commands.name: insertText
commands.description: Inserts text at the input focus of the session's display, as text that does not come from a key press (as CDP Input.insertText). No input focus: NOT_ACTIONABLE.

There are no meta state or repeat count parameters: a modifier is expressed by pressing and releasing the modifier key itself (for example ACTION_DOWN KEYCODE_SHIFT_LEFT, then the key, then ACTION_UP KEYCODE_SHIFT_LEFT).

types.description: Opaque ID of an upload. An upload belongs to the connection and session that created it and is single-use: install consumes it. It is discarded when the connection closes, when its session ends, and after the upload idle-expiry setting passes without a command naming it.

commands.name: createUpload
commands.description: Starts an upload of size bytes. size above the server's maximum upload size (a server setting), or 0: INVALID_PARAMS, before any bytes are sent. A session that already holds the maximum number of unfinished uploads (a server setting): INVALID_REQUEST.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Total byte count.

returns.name: maxChunkSize
returns.description: The largest chunk payload in bytes uploadChunk accepts for this upload (the chunk-size server setting).

commands.name: uploadChunk
commands.description: Appends the payload of the client binary message that follows this Request (envelope.binary) to the upload. At most one uploadChunk per upload is in flight; a second: INVALID_REQUEST. A payload of 0 bytes or above maxChunkSize, one that would pass size, or an uploadId that names no unfinished upload of this session: INVALID_PARAMS, and nothing is appended.

returns.name: received
returns.description: Total bytes appended so far.

commands.name: finishUpload
commands.description: Finishes the upload. Fewer bytes received than size: INVALID_PARAMS, and the upload stays unfinished. A digest that does not match the received bytes: INVALID_PARAMS, and the upload is discarded. sha256 not 64 lowercase hex digits, or an uploadId that names no unfinished upload of this session: INVALID_PARAMS.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) of all size bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Installs the uploaded APKs through an android.content.pm.PackageInstaller session. A result other than PackageInstaller.STATUS_SUCCESS: NOT_ACTIONABLE with error.data {status: the name of the PackageInstaller STATUS_* constant, legacyStatus: PackageManager.installStatusToString of PackageInstaller.EXTRA_LEGACY_STATUS, absent when the result carries none}.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Starts an activity of packageName with Context.startActivity; Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK is always added, as the am start command does. Without activity and intent: the Intent PackageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName) returns; none: NOT_ACTIONABLE. With activity: an explicit Intent for that component.
